qualification: Assessment retains an exact sealed completed directory inventory and performs no native IO, writes, probe, pathname reopening, name normalization or filesystem-label inference. Twelve native feature advertisements, read-only mount observations and two recorded creation-access observations remain independently inspectable.

Context requires qualified directory anchor/before/after identity and kind, matching location owners, known coherent native query family and identity scheme, and coherent known feature domain. Contradictory available filesystem query IDs/type/serial, mount/case/inode flags and modified/changed timestamps fail qualification. Missing optional observations are not invented. This is bounded live evidence, not an atomic snapshot.

Raw before/after feature-query failures retain exact state/domain/code/operation before feature mapping. Different available advertisements yield Changed. Advertised/NotAdvertised are native advertisements, never proof of preservation support or feature absence. Linux has no generic native advertisement mapping and stays explicit.

Creation assessment preserves native access refusal first, then validates exact owner, requested operation, native query family and sufficient access mask. Windows requires FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES/SYNCHRONIZE plus requested add right; Linux/Darwin require write/search. Extra sufficient rights are allowed. Read-only mount state remains independently inspectable. AccessReportedWithoutReadOnlyMount does not authorize creation or account for immutable flags, names, quota, inheritance, providers or execution.

All newly retained diagnostic strings, including fixed invalid-request observations, are charged to a default1MiB/hard8MiB quota. Exhaustion returns no partial result and leaves input intact. Already-owned inventory storage is separate. Const noexcept getters do no IO/allocation. Worker result retains its original native inventory until retirement.

Nine new deterministic cases cover no extra IO and exact retention, native platform mappings independent of labels, changed/missing feature validity, all six unavailable states before/after including unmapped-feature failure priority, unqualified identity/kind/owner/family/domain, optional context contradictions, access owner/family/masks, independent read-only/access failures, exact/one-short diagnostic budgets and invalid requests.

Native259-entry pipeline adds a completed held directory inventory and qualifies its assessment on APFS/macOS, ext4/Linux and ReFS/Windows. All twelve derived states/values/errors are compared to raw native advertisement mapping; each creation observation is compared to the actual access/read-only query. Existing100000 synthetic native-cache and259 real-directory filtering/marks/source/held-inventory markers remain required.

limitations: WP-01 remains in progress; WP-02 through WP-08 remain unstarted. Full preservation/collision capabilities, remaining composition and broader filesystem qualification are required.

Feature advertisement does not prove that a specific source can be preserved. These observations do not authorize native mutation, waive metadata loss, freeze directory state, or replace source review, collision/name checks, preservation inventory and fresh operation validation.

Optional unavailable IDs/flags are not invented; context Same only qualifies available directory bookends. Known changed facts and mismatched owners reject qualification. Provider, quota, inherited security, immutable flags and execution failures need operation-specific handling.

Limits bound newly retained diagnostics and fixed feature/access slots, not already-owned inventory payload or process RSS/global queues. Application worker/result retention must be bounded separately. Cancellation of underlying native queries remains cooperative.

Positive native qualification covers APFS, ext4 and ReFS on these hosts. Other filesystem/provider combinations, remote/removable/crash/full-disk/different-account operation behavior remain unqualified.

No Files UI/rendered-window, full-app latency/RSS or100000-real-directory claim. Existing100000 cache-record coverage is synthetic; native directory integration has259 entries. Copy/move/delete and scoped metadata-loss consent are not implemented.
